_: The file-to-test map (areas.mjs). Each changed path takes the areas of the first pattern it matches (globs: * one segment, ** any). A path no pattern matches means ALL. Areas: static (T0's checks: always), frames (T1, the frames and the DOM), gpu (T2, the RTX 4090), harness (the gates' own code: it changes how a build is judged, never what is served; which gates run is decided by the builds and by areas.mjs's harness rule, not by this area), none (nothing shipped or tested). The merge bot re-gates a PR only when main changed one of its areas since its gate's base, so a harness PR and a site PR land side by side: main's gate then runs the new harness on the new site, and the deploy gate waits for it.
